tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
Ubiquiti UniFi CloudKey+ (UCK-G2-PLUS) – Next-Gen Cloud-Based Network Controller

The Ubiquiti UniFi CloudKey+ (UCK-G2-PLUS) is a powerful, cloud-based network controller designed for centralized UniFi device management. Featuring a built-in 1TB HDD (upgradeable to 5TB), it not only serves as a UniFi Network Controller but also acts as a UniFi Protect NVR for managing surveillance cameras. With a quad-core processor, 2GB RAM, and secure remote access, this device ensures seamless network and security camera management for businesses, offices, hotels, and enterprises.

Key Features:

  • All-in-One Network & Video Management – UniFi Network & UniFi Protect in one device
  • Powerful Quad-Core Processor – Smooth and efficient performance for large networks
  • Built-in 1TB HDD (Expandable to 5TB) – Stores security footage effortlessly
  • Cloud-Based Remote Access – Manage your network & security from anywhere
  • Seamless UniFi Ecosystem Integration – Supports UniFi Access Points, Switches, and Cameras
  • PoE & USB-C Powered – Flexible power options for easy deployment
  • Enterprise-Grade Security & Performance – Secure and scalable for business networks

Why Choose the UniFi CloudKey+ (UCK-G2-PLUS)?

  • Effortless Centralized Network Management

  • Perfect for Businesses, Hotels, Offices & Enterprises

  • Remote Monitoring & Secure Cloud Access

  • Integrated Video Surveillance with UniFi Protect

Upgrade to the Ubiquiti UniFi CloudKey+ (UCK-G2-PLUS) for seamless, high-performance network and security management.
